snippet.title: Babu Me Baby! - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Haruki Osanai is just trying to get by in life, but too much stress from work has taken a toll on him. His physician resorts to an unusual method to help him relieve stress... Hypnosis! However, things take an unexpected turn...
